verdict.rationale: Jira's own features page says it offers pre-built and customizable project templates, ranging from agile sprints to marketing campaigns, so a new project can start fast. That matches the story directly. The evidence is a single marketing line with no deeper documentation or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the template catalog and setup flow, independent or community confirmation of template use.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can jumpstart a new project using pre-built templates

citations.quote: Start fast with pre-built and customizable templates for any project, from agile sprints to marketing campaigns.
